name: financial-company-analyzer
description: Professional financial analysis workspace: structure, validate and interpret company financials.

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fca/server" "npm run dev -w @fca/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @fca/server && npm run build -w @fca/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fca/core && npm run typecheck -w @fca/server && npm run typecheck -w @fca/client
